context: Scatter plot of 105 synthetic generated blocks plotting prompt word count (x) vs composite quality score (y), with circle size encoding skill count and color encoding category; includes brush-to-filter interaction and callout annotations.
first_impression: Structurally honest scatter plot that correctly uses scaleSqrt for area encoding and key functions for data joins.
what_works: Circle size uses d3.scaleSqrt (line 126) — correct area encoding with no lie factor. Data join uses .data(data, d => d.id) key function (line 197), ensuring object constancy under permutation.
what_doesnt: Y domain is hardcoded at [10, 100] rather than derived from data — subset removal won't shift the y-axis (acceptable), but a shift/scale transform on scores could push values out of view without domain adjustment. X domain uses d3.extent recalculated from the full dataset at render time, so it would jump if the dataset were subsetted dynamically.
